# Rules reference

Built-in rules `aact check` runs. Each page below is generated from the
rule's own metadata — description, rationale, and good/bad examples.

| Rule | Fix | Description |
| --- | :---: | --- |
| [`acl`](./acl.md) | 🔧 | Containers calling external systems must be tagged as ACL (Anti-corruption Layer) |
| [`acyclic`](./acyclic.md) |  | Dependency graph between containers must be acyclic (no cycles) |
| [`apiGateway`](./apiGateway.md) |  | ACL containers calling external systems must route through an API Gateway |
| [`crud`](./crud.md) | 🔧 | Direct database access only through repo/relay containers; repos must access databases only |
| [`dbPerService`](./dbPerService.md) | 🔧 | Each database container must have a single owner (one repo/relay per DB) |
| [`cohesion`](./cohesion.md) |  | Each boundary should be more cohesive than coupled; parent boundaries less cohesive than inner ones |
| [`stableDependencies`](./stableDependencies.md) |  | Dependencies should point toward more stable containers (instability calculation) |
| [`commonReuse`](./commonReuse.md) |  | Consumers using part of a boundary's public surface should use all of it |
